c.tagline: The gateway city to Slovakia's soaring High Tatras.

taxi.fareNote: Ride-hailing coverage is limited in Poprad — Bolt operates but with few drivers, so local taxis remain the reliable option. Confirm the meter is on or agree a price in advance.

emergency.note: 112 is the general EU-style emergency number reaching police, fire, and ambulance; mountain rescue in the Tatras is 18 300.

hood_desc: The lively heart of Poprad along Námestie sv. Egídia, a long pedestrian square lined with pastel houses, cafes, shops and the town church; close to the train and bus stations and the departure point for the High Tatras, it is the most convenient base.

Poprad's best-preserved historic quarter, a medieval square of Renaissance burgher houses and the St George church founded by German colonists; the prettiest and most atmospheric place to stay, minutes from AquaCity.
A large, modern residential district south of the centre with apartment blocks, shopping, the ice stadium and everyday amenities; practical and well-priced rather than scenic.
The geothermal AquaCity resort and the wooded Kvetnica valley on the town's edge, built around thermal pools, spa hotels and forest walks; a relaxed nature-and-wellness base under the Tatras.
A former standalone town now a quiet historic suburb of Poprad, with its own church, square and small-town feel; a calm, local area a short ride from the centre.

water.note: Tap water is safe — Tatra mountain water is excellent.

transit.hours: City buses run from roughly 5:00 AM to around 11:00 PM; the Tatra Electric Railway (TEŽ) up to the mountain resorts runs from early morning until late evening.
transit.note: Poprad is compact and walkable. City buses (MHD Poprad) cover the town, while the narrow-gauge Tatra Electric Railway (TEŽ) from Poprad-Tatry links the city to Starý Smokovec, Štrbské Pleso and the High Tatra resorts.
transit.pay: Buy bus tickets in cash from the driver or with a transit card; TEŽ mountain-railway tickets are sold at stations, machines and online, and regional TATRY travel passes cover multiple days.

train: Poprad-Tatry station on the main Bratislava–Košice line ( ZSSK )
Tatra Electric Railway (TEŽ) to the High Tatra resorts

transit.m: City bus to the centre (~15 min)

tip.r: Not obligatory; rounding up the bill or leaving ~10% for good service is customary and appreciated.
